overall_judgment: The review correctly identifies two non-negotiable identification failures in the candidate plan: generator origin was bound to a single realized output, and the natural audit lacked a probability sampling frame and denominator. Most operational fixes are adopted. Two recommendations are narrowed because they are budget-policy choices rather than scientific prerequisites, and one generation-replicate gate is rejected as undefined under the proposed mutant/control assignment.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Freeze one primary estimand and contrast, units, denominators, extraction, missingness and numeric gates before inference.
decisions.local_reasoning: This directly prevents post-result denominator changes and pseudoreplication without adding model cost.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Added Phase 0 as a mandatory zero-call no-go gate for all later phases.

decisions.reviewer_claim: A single realized output per origin cannot identify same-family bias; downgrade the estimand to reviewer by generator-output interaction unless style and origin are independently manipulated.
decisions.local_reasoning: Anonymization does not remove origin-linked wording, quality or defect visibility, so causal same-family language would exceed the design.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Renamed Phase 3 and limited its conclusion to an operational interaction signal that would require a fresh holdout.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Use at least 12 runtime mutants and 12 independent clean controls; repetitions are repeated measurements, not new samples.
decisions.local_reasoning: The 12 plus 12 runtime minimum is adopted. Six surface mutants and six independent controls are retained only as a preregistered negative-control family because they add no reviewer calls and can expose a nonspecific context effect.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Phase 1 now freezes 36 unique source items and treats item as the inferential unit; surface results are secondary.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Remove lint-detectable items from the model experiment and evaluate them with deterministic tooling.
decisions.local_reasoning: They do not answer the runtime-context question and would dilute the primary denominator.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Lint coverage is a separate deterministic report and is excluded from the model primary analysis.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Freeze extraction, length, missingness and leakage rules before mutation/reference reveal; A and B must otherwise be byte-identical.
decisions.local_reasoning: Without this, hand-selected evidence could encode the answer and destroy the ablation.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Phase 1 specifies a manifest-driven code-only extractor, one-callee limit, deterministic truncation, CONTEXT_MISSING and reject-on-leak checks.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Adopt one primary contrast, one false-positive guardrail and frozen numeric go/no-go rules.
decisions.local_reasoning: The proposed 0.20 recall, 0.05 candidate-rate and per-route maximum are useful operational materiality rules, but the small item count cannot justify power or significance claims.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Adopted the numeric gates, labeled them budget/input-contract policies, and made failure or mixed results default to source/target-only with no third run.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Freeze a target population, unique probability sampling frame, inclusion probabilities, weights, unknown provenance and indeterminate/unreachable denominator rules.
decisions.local_reasoning: These are prerequisites for any population-rate statement rather than a convenience-sample proportion.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Phase 2 uses a frozen snapshot, provenance strata, PPS task sampling, seeded within-task selection, explicit weights and lower/upper identification bounds.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Lock uniform source audits before exposing model nominations and retain unknown provenance.
decisions.local_reasoning: This reduces nomination-driven search-depth bias and preserves the full sampling denominator.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: All 40 source audits are locked first with confirmed, refuted, indeterminate or unreachable verdicts; four model calls occur only afterward.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Run the natural residual audit first and launch the origin pilot only if residual prevalence and provenance cross a gate.
decisions.local_reasoning: The ordering is efficient for this project, but natural prevalence is not a scientific identifiability prerequisite for a controlled reviewer-output interaction study.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Reordered the phases and made four confirmed residuals across four tasks a budget-priority gate only, explicitly not a validity claim.

decisions.topic: Independent generation replicates and complete blocks
decisions.reviewer_claim: Generate at least two baselines per item and origin, use frozen reserves, analyze only complete clean blocks and report origin-specific failures and natural defects.
decisions.local_reasoning: This reduces binding to a single realization and makes origin-dependent selection visible, though it does not identify psychological bias.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Phase 3 freezes 16 ordered items, requires 12 complete 4-origin by 2-generation blocks, and stops without repair if fewer are available.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Require the primary contrast to have the same direction in both generation replicates.
decisions.local_reasoning: Under the recommended design, one of the two generation outputs in each item-origin block is mutant and the other is control. A mutant-origin detection contrast is therefore not separately estimable for each generation label without changing the design or introducing confounding.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Generation assignment is handled as a balanced block/repeated-measure factor; stability gates use two reviewer runs and leave-one-item-out analysis instead.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Predeclare one GPT-reviewer contrast, cluster by source item, control design factors and make the full reviewer-origin matrix secondary.
decisions.local_reasoning: This limits researcher degrees of freedom and treats routes and repeated observations correctly.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: The sole primary contrast is GPT reviewer risk difference on GPT-origin versus pooled non-GPT-origin mutants; all other cells are descriptive.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Define FINDING versus correct UNCERTAIN, report tokens/failures/audit labor, disclose fixed-order limits, and verify ordering, arm differences, anonymization and reserves.
decisions.local_reasoning: These additions improve auditability and prevent opportunity counts from being mistaken for independent evidence.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: Added mutually explicit detection reporting, fixed-route/run limitations, full cost accounting and expanded verifier requirements.

decisions.topic: Natural residuals as a scientific launch prerequisite
decisions.reviewer_claim: Do not use controlled mutations as an artificial reason to proceed if natural residuals fail the launch gate.
decisions.local_reasoning: A controlled interaction pilot can answer a method question even when the production residual is rare. Low prevalence can rationally lower project priority, but it does not make the controlled estimand invalid.
decisions.revised_plan_effect: The natural-audit gate controls current-project budget priority only; a separately motivated future controlled study would require a new freeze, not a claim of scientific prohibition.

key_changes: Added a zero-call preregistration and identifiability phase.
Expanded the context pilot to 12 independent runtime mutants and 12 controls, removed lint from model inference, and mechanically froze context extraction.
Moved the natural audit ahead of the origin study and supplied a probability frame, weights, unknown-provenance stratum and explicit identification bounds.
Downgraded same-family-bias language to an operational reviewer by generator-output interaction and added independent generation replicates and complete clean blocks.
Rejected an undefined generation-direction gate and separated scientific validity from project budget priority.
residual_risks: The proposed numeric gates are materiality policies, not powered hypothesis tests.
Forty natural items can yield only wide bounds when residuals are rare.
Complete-block filtering limits the origin estimand to items for which all origins produce source-verifiable clean outputs.
Anonymization cannot fully separate recognizable style from true generator origin.
Without an independent native-language adjudicator, conclusions remain limited to objective source-verifiable mechanics.
